plain_english_revision: This amendment grants free toll passes to permanent residents of Mobile County and Baldwin County for any toll fees under the specified state chapter.
candidate_position_supported: The candidate supports expanding eligibility for tax-exempt or fee-waived toll passes to permanent residents of Mobile County and Baldwin County, effectively reducing transportation costs for these specific groups.
evidence_quotes: A permanent resident of Mobile County or Baldwin County shall be eligible for a free toll pass
for any toll fee issued pursuant to Article 5 of Chapter 2 of Title 23.
